topics.title: In-Memory Flag Evaluation & Rule Trees
topics.objective: Evaluate Boolean and multivariate feature toggles in sub-millisecond in-memory pipelines.
topics.exercise: Build an in-memory rule evaluator supporting Boolean flags and default fallbacks.

topics.title: Contextual User Targeting & Cohorts
topics.objective: Target feature releases to specific user cohorts based on attributes (country, beta_tester, tier).
topics.exercise: Write an attribute evaluation rule matcher supporting string, numeric, and regex comparisons.

topics.title: Deterministic Percentage Rollouts (MurmurHash3)
topics.objective: Distribute traffic gradually across percentage buckets deterministically without storing per-user state.
topics.example: bucket = murmur3(userId + flagKey) % 100; return bucket < rolloutPercent;
topics.exercise: Implement a deterministic percentage rollout function and test uniform distribution across 10,000 keys.

topics.title: Operational Kill Switches & Automated Rollback
topics.objective: Halt problematic code paths instantly when telemetry error thresholds are breached.
topics.exercise: Connect flag evaluation to an error monitor that automatically disables a feature flag on sustained 5xx spikes.

topics.title: Technical Debt Cleanup & Flag Lifecycle Governance
topics.objective: Audit, sunset, and remove stale feature flags from codebases safely.
topics.example: FLAG_DEPRECATION_DATE: 2026-12-01 // Alert on un-removed flags older than 60 days
topics.exercise: Write an automated AST lint script that flags any toggle references with expiration dates in the past.
